title: Exact-match-first with conditional suffix matching to prevent collisions
context: Three path-matching bugs arose from conflicting strategies: bare endsWith caused substring false positives (db.ts→mongodb.ts), same-basename files pulled unrelated rules (index.ts collisions), and absolute paths never matched repo-relative stored paths. Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Establish a three-tier matching precedence: (1) normalize absolute paths to repo-relative form before any matching, (2) exact full-path matches take priority, (3) segment-anchored suffix matching applies only when the target is not itself a real indexed file. This ensures each matching strategy has a non-overlapping scope.
consequences: Substring false positives eliminated (endsWith→pathsRelated with segment boundaries)
Same-basename collisions prevented (suffix matching skipped for real files)
Absolute paths from agents now match their repo-relative equivalents in constraints
Suffix fallback reserved for partial/incomplete references, not full indexed paths
alternatives_rejected: Apply a single matching strategy uniformly (reintroduces false positives or collisions)
Use suffix matching for all targets regardless of whether they're indexed files (keeps same-basename bug)
Leave absolute paths unmapped (breaks agent edit payloads that pass absolute paths)
